description: The card's overflow marker wraps: "+1" / "+2" renders as "+" stacked over the digit beside the three marker avatars. The geometry audit misses it because it is a span, not a control.
expected: "+2" on one line, styled like the header's round "+4" chip.
suggested_fix: white-space: nowrap and a min-width on the card overflow marker (reuse the header chip style).

description: After opening a task, the viewer is counted in that task's "Here now" on the card ("2 more Actors" includes Priya) and in the panel (PR last). It tells the viewer nothing and uses one of the 3 card slots / the overflow count.
expected: The viewer's own marker is omitted from their own view of Here now (others still see it).
actual: Priya sees herself in the card's +2 and in the panel.
suggested_fix: Filter the current Actor out of focus markers in the local view.

description: Card markers look like the clickable header avatars but clicking one opens the card; reaching a person's profile from the card takes card → panel → avatar.
expected: Either markers open the profile, or they look non-interactive (no hover/focus styling resembling buttons).
actual: Clicking Maya's marker opened the task panel (no dialog).
suggested_fix: Accept as designed but reduce affordance, or make markers separate buttons outside the card button.
